appDescription: Arion is a voice-only test of ArriveOn restaurant recommendations and simulated reservations in Seoul Forest.

function.name: FIND_TEST_RESTAURANTS
function.description: Find and read fictional restaurant options around Seoul Forest for the requested group size.

children.description: Whole child count between 0 and 6. Use zero when no children are requested.

function.name: SELECT_TEST_RESTAURANT
function.description: Select a numbered Arion restaurant option and read its proposed simulated reservation details for review.

candidateOrdinal.description: The previously announced restaurant option number, between 1 and 3.

function.name: APPROVE_TEST_RESERVATION
function.description: Submit the selected simulated reservation only when the user explicitly approves that numbered option after hearing its details.

candidateOrdinal.description: The previously selected restaurant number explicitly approved by the user.
